messages.subject: B.Grimm Power | Smart Grid, industrial energy and public-private execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Karnasuta and B.Grimm Power Leadership Team,

Your current focus on Smart Grid development, industrial energy solutions and stronger public-private coordination in Thailand closely matches the type of work I lead from the stakeholder side of a major industrial operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory engagement, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring practical energy-transition experience rather than policy exposure alone. I have supported governance and external engagement around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage in a remote mine-energy system. I also coordinate multi-agency approvals, stakeholder commitments and carbon-data readiness. This background fits the institutional work around private grids, microgrids, renewable integration and industrial energy growth.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, Malaysia or wider regional mandates in Government Relations, External Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or energy-sector stakeholder leadership. I have attached a B.Grimm Power-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
